core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mirza is a Persian-origin name meaning “Prince, noble-born”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mirza corresponds to the Persian form ميرزا (Persian مِيرْزَا (Mīrzā)). Its core sense is mirza; a persian title and given name. Mirza is the Persian title and male given name مِيرْزَا (Mīrzā) 'prince, noble-born', widely used in South Asia. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave مرزا (a different form) and labelled the origin Arabic; the correct form is مِيرْزَا and the name is Persian. The source gloss 'Prince or Noble Born' is broadly consistent.

persian.name: میرزا
persian.long_meaning: Mirza (میرزا) نامی برگرفته از زبان فارسی است و معنای اصلی آن میرزا، لقب و نام است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
